title: Character Name Origins: Encoded Destinies
description: Hidden meanings tucked inside famous character names.

questions.question: Old Danish 'Hamlet' means a small what?
questions.explanation: Hamlet suggests someone caught between worlds—like the prince.

questions.question: Hamlet means village—Tolkien's Sindarin name Mithrandir for Gandalf means what?
questions.explanation: A wanderer between light and darkness.

questions.question: Grey Pilgrim aside—Rowling's 'Severus' suggests what quality in Snape?
questions.explanation: Severus evokes severity—his harsh exterior hides protection.

questions.question: That stern Severus—his surname echoes what sharp sound a whip makes?
questions.explanation: Snape/snape wordplay hints at cutting remarks—a whip's crack.

questions.question: That whip-crack surname aside—Luke Skywalker's original name before Lucas changed it was what?
questions.explanation: Early drafts used Starkiller before softening to Skywalker.
